Package com.im.njams.sdk.serializer

Class XmlSerializer<T>

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.im.njams.sdk.serializer.XmlSerializer<T>
  • Type Parameters:
    T - the type of object to serialize
    All Implemented Interfaces:
    Serializer<T>
    public class XmlSerializer<T>
extends Object
implements Serializer<T>
    Serializer implementation that converts objects to their XML string representation using Jackson's XML data format.

    By default, the serializer produces compact output. Pass true to XmlSerializer(boolean) to obtain indented, human-readable output instead. No XML prolog (<?xml ...?>) is emitted.

    Both serialize methods return null when the object is null.

    • Constructor Detail

      • XmlSerializer

        public XmlSerializer()
        Creates a serializer that produces compact (non-pretty-printed) XML output.

      • XmlSerializer

        public XmlSerializer​(boolean pretty)
        Creates a serializer with the given pretty-printing setting.

        When pretty is true, the output is indented, human-readable XML; when false, compact output optimized for performance is produced. No XML prolog is emitted in either case.

        Parameters:
        pretty - true for indented, human-readable XML; false for compact output

      • serialize

        public SerializerResult serialize​(T object,
                                  int sizeLimit)
                           throws NjamsSdkRuntimeException
        Serialize the given object to an XML string, stopping near sizeLimit characters and reporting whether the output was truncated.

        The value may slightly exceed sizeLimit due to internal buffering. sizeLimit <= 0 or sizeLimit == Integer.MAX_VALUE mean "no limit" and route to the unlimited fast path (never truncated). Otherwise the stream is aborted once the limit is reached, and SerializerResult.truncated() is true exactly when that happened (i.e. the object was larger than sizeLimit). A truncated value may be incomplete and therefore not well-formed XML.

        Specified by:
        serialize in interface Serializer<T>
        Parameters:
        object - Object to serialize, may be null
        sizeLimit - Approximate maximum length of the produced string
        Returns:
        the XML value (possibly clipped) and its truncation flag, or null if object is null
        Throws:
        NjamsSdkRuntimeException - if Jackson fails for a reason other than the size limit
